name: Doujinshi Sokubaikai o Yarou!
original_name: 同人誌即売会をやろう！
source:
A talented artist with dreams and charisma, the protagonist has strived to lead a doujinshi circle towards success. Sadly, despite his ambition and drive, he lacks the financial resources and experience to break the barriers… until a beautiful woman offers both, expecting nothing in return except his best effort. Her future is now intertwined with his: can he prove to be the success she believes him to be?

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
translation:
才华横溢、怀揣梦想且极具号召力的青年画师男主角，一直努力带领同人社团冲击业界巅峰。遗憾的是，空有满腔抱负与干劲的他始终缺乏打破瓶颈所需的资金与经验……直到一位美貌女性主动向他伸出援手、同时奉上资金与指导，唯一的条件便是要求他全力以赴。自此，她的未来与男主角的命运紧紧交织在了一起——他究竟能否不负所托，拼出她所坚信的辉煌成就？

[摘自Nargrakhan撰写的[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]旧评测[/url]]
